newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia stocks seen mixed after Dow, metals move.
newsitem.headline: Australia stocks seen mixed after Dow, metals move.

text.p: *Stocks seen mixed as yield stocks seen performing well, while high P/E stocks seen under pressure. "I think it is going to be a bit directionless today," one Brisbane broker said.
*Wall Street stocks ended broadly higher with the Dow indutsrials rebonding from sharp losses and Nasdaq rolling to its sixth consecutive record.
*ADRs: News Corp 19-/05 (+0/01), BHP 27-7/8 (+/01), WMC 23-/05 (-/06), National Australia Bank 73-0/13 (+0/15).
*COMEX gold ended higher, although London gold fixed at 12 year low. LME copper bounced a touch on technical factors, other base metals were mixed. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
